digest.component_or_area: Jira DC capability mapping CI workflow
propositions: A manually-dispatched CI job must boot the pinned Jira DC image, interrogate its capability vocabulary (issue types, workflows, statuses, priorities, link types, and field limits), and emit structured evidence (raw request/response pairs) rather than prose summaries.

The job's output must remain committed data consumed by harness setup assertions and must never auto-derive answers at test time, breaking the cycle of 35-minute discovery loops on single configuration questions.

The declared environment contract must capture both issue type names AND their subtask flags, both transition names AND their destination status names, and for link types the inward/outward direction flags and their inverse relationship (blocks/depends_on), since name-only checks cannot catch direction inversions.

The image digest must be derived from the Dockerfile's FROM line at runtime and committed alongside the capability answers, with no duplicate hardcoded constant; the staleness of answers after a re-pin must be automatically detectable by comparing reported digest against the Dockerfile pin.

Field length limits (summary 254, label 255, description/comment 32767) must be measured empirically at limit-1/limit/limit+1 with read-back verification to detect silent truncation, rather than assumed; jira.text.field.character.limit must be read from instance state rather than hardcoded.

The workflow must be testable as dispatch-only (no push/PR/schedule triggers) with assertions rather than configuration, and the agent must operate in read-only mode with REBAR_MCP_READONLY=1 to guarantee no mutation of the Jira instance.
